about: NewsGenie demo data: 2 organizations, 5 users and 90 days per organization and product. Loaded into the database the first time the backend starts (or with npm run reset-db). Built-in trends: The Daily Planet has a comment spike 12-16 days before the last day and a bot-traffic surge over the last 10 days; Metro Times has a rising share of flagged comments over the last 3 weeks.
